verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a SaaS product could publish llms.txt or machine-readable docs. But probes returned HTTP 404 for both https://launchdarkly.com/llms.txt and https://launchdarkly.com/docs.md, and no evidence shows agent-oriented docs. The documented MCP server and CLI are separate agent-integration capabilities, not agent-readable documentation, so they are not credited here. Confidence is medium rather than high because the probes did not check docs-subpath variants such as /docs/llms.txt.
